'''Czerka tripod battledroid''' was a line of a military droids manufactured by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]], which were widely utilized during the wars between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> It was the most common type of a three-legged droid used by Czerka itself, differentiated from other tripods, such as [[Czerka Warden droid|Czerka Warden droids]] or [[Tank Buster droid|Tank Busters]], by its round body shape with an oval cavity in the middle where two visual sensors were located, reminiscent of the design of [[Czerka Personnel droid|Czerka Personnel droids]].<ref name="miner">{{TORcite|type=enemy|[[Czerka Personnel droid|Czerka Mining Unit]]|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the "No Spies Allowed!" Dynamic Encounter}}</ref>

Multiple series of tripod battledroids existed, some used without a classical green Czerka paint-job.<ref name="Tatooine">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Timely Arrival|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] and [[Moon/Legends|moons]] on which Czerka Corporation, and later Czerka Interstellar, utilized tripod battledroids included [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="tatooine2">{{TORcite|type=enemy|Impressive Battledroid|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]],<ref name="corellia">{{TORcite|type=enemy|Czerka Assault Droid|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref> [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]],<ref name="dxun">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=operation|Nature of Progress}}</ref> and [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="Dantooine" />

==History==
Czerka tripods were utilized by the Corporation in its operations on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Not colored [[Czerka Mark 4 Droid|Mark 4 models]] were among [[Gayem Leksende]]'s forces deployed to stop [[SIS operation on Tatooine|SIS activities]] there.<ref name="Tatooine" /> Destroyed green-colored Czerka tripod battledroids were found in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], and a number of them were repaired by local [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] near a trading camp of [[Ch'hedt]]. The droids, however, turned on Jawas, and they had to call upon a passerby help.<ref name="Another Scavanger's Tale">{{TORcite|type=dynamic|Another Scavanger's Tale|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

Tripod battledroid was one of the three [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] droid types presented at the [[Seario Memorial Showroom]] on [[CZ-198]], the other two being [[Czerka Personnel droid]] and [[Czerka Probe droid]].<ref name="CZ labs">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=flashpoint|Czerka Corporate Labs}}</ref>

A notable models of a Czerka tripod battledroid included:
*[[Czerka Mark 4 Droid]]<ref name="Tatooine" />
*[[CZ-W4 Observer Droid]]<ref name="pet">{{TORcite|type=other|[[CZ-W4 Observer Droid]] pet}}</ref>
